people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”
translations.bsb: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
translations.asv: And Jesus said unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the heaven have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
